reviews.text: This veterinary practice in Philadelphia provided exceptional service. They accommodated my cat for a same-day appointment and demonstrated understanding regarding my delayed arrival due to traffic. The staff exhibited remarkable professionalism and a clear dedication to animal welfare, consistently striving to provide the best possible care for pets.

This clinic is fine for routine exams, vaccines and dentals but I don't recommend for actual problems. My cat was struggling with severe cold/allergy-like symptoms and I was told it was "probably a tumor" and she'd need to get an expensive scan to confirm and then be euthanized. I went elsewhere and got her nasal discharge swabbed as part of a feline respiratory panel and turns out she has a bacterial infection requiring a special antibiotic.

Also, I was a client for several years when I lived in the area and while their website says they will take urgent cases without an appointment if you call 1st, they denied me on THREE occasions over the yrs when I needed to bring my cat in saying they were "too busy" each time. I ended up having extremely positive experiences at Art City Vets Urgent Care who I definitely recommend.

I took my dog, Clover, here after receiving a recommendation from a friend. She’s a very anxious dog, so I was hesitant to try a new vet. I couldn’t be happier with my decision to switch. The staff made the process of her sedated exam/bloodwork as easy and stress-free as possible for her! They are also quick to answer questions and very helpful. They are transparent in their pricing, and I found their prices to be much more reasonable than others in the area.
New to the neighborhood with 2 cats and 2 dogs at home. Instantly noticed how much better the care and experience is here. Definitely recommend.

Took my 12 year old dog there for the first time and had such a great experience! The tech and doctor were both incredibly nice. The office was efficient. They took great care of Bella! So glad I found them.

I had brought my cat here consistently for  regular annual visits, including 2 dentals($$$$)since I adopted her many years ago. We had received great care here over the years by Dr. Meister and several other vets who came and went. My cat  suddenly stopped eating and drinking so I called them.  I asked if I should bring her to VSEC urgent care(my first thought), they said No, that’s expensive just to get her in and Dr.Cohen should see her first). I was able to get an “emergency” appointment with Dr. Cohen (that’s an extra charge right there$$$) This was during Covid, so I wasn’t allowed in the office(I waited in the car and communication wasn’t great). although some of his “favorite” patients were allowed in. He did bloodwork, then prescribed two meds  and recommended an ultrasound (which they don’t do, but VSEC does!). The meds didn’t help and She wasn’t improving so I took her to VSEC for the ultrasound and to be seen. I called while at VSEC, I called both Dr. Cohen and the center City vet office for advice, but nobody answered. In the end, she was put to sleep. This vet is ok for routine care, but for any emergency. I’d bypass them and go to VSEC(or any urgent vet care) despite what this place says . Dr. Cohen and staff
still never did call  to follow up
UPDATE: upon seeing this review, Dr. Cohen called me to YELL at me almost THREE months after I put my cat to sleep because of a poor(but honest) review! I have receipts/emails/witnesses to support my claims. He told me he would’ve put her on steroids if he had known!? I Called his cell and the office  during working hours while at VSEC and no one answered. How could a vet call a patient because they didn’t like a poor review and YELL at them, making them  feel as if they did the wrong thing by ending their pets suffering?! I had finally stopped crying daily over losing my cat and now I’m grieving all over again thanks to Dr. Cohen’s ego. Dr. cohen  yelled  at me over the phone as I was literally sobbing.  The last thing I said to him as I was crying was”Why are you doing this to me?!” Unprofessional egomaniac Never again will I go here. 😿😭

I love how welcoming the team is. From the very first visit, I felt at home—especially when they put my kitten’s name on the welcome board the day of her first appointment. The team was there for me during an incredibly difficult time, remaining open, compassionate, and available while my cat was ill and even after her passing. Their support meant so much to me. I continue to bring my pets here because of the genuine care they show.

first time here and there was an insanely noticeable difference from the experiences I've had at other city vets. fast service, quality care, and its extremely affordable compared to other spots.

the vet was so kind and eased all my anxiety for my cat. they definitely know their stuff!!

recommended to me by a friend and let me be the friend to recommend them to you.

I will be switching here for good 😸
I wouldn't take my rats anywhere else. Dr. Meister is amazing, as are the girls that run the desk (especially Melissa!)

I took my dog to this hospital for years, I highly trusted this vet. My 11-year-old dog developed a Chronic cough last September. I took him in got him x-rays, blood test and the vet told me everything looked good it was probably just allergies. I did everything for my dog, daily recommended allergy medication, I bought an air purifier, Got a plastic cover for my mattress to protect him from mattress, borne allergens still the cough, persisted. The vet was well aware of a pre-existing heart murmur, and never once suggested considering heart medication for the murmur. After nearly a year and repeat visits for his chronic cough I finally took him to a different vet. The new Vet Reviewed the X-rays taken by CENTER CITY vet and was very quickly able to identify the enlargement of his heart on one side Causing the stage 4 murmur. My pet last saw a center of city vet back in May For his chronic cough But still, the vet couldn’t peace together with all of the information he had gathered over the last several years that the chronic cough was due to the heart murmur that was identified years prior. The owner of this veterinary hospital refused to refund me for all of the visits where I was sent home with nothing but recommendations for repeat work. More x-rays, more panels, more tests When all the information was there from the jump. I watched my dog suffer from a failing heart for a year because of this veterinary clinic. Everyone here is super nice, but I feel wholeheartedly that these vets are ill equipped and taking your pet here may put them in a life-threatening situation like it put mine.
Dr. Meister is always so helpful with our pets. He really takes the time to discuss our concerns, confirm we understand what's going on, and ensure we know we can always follow up.

Great service every time. I take both of my kitties here for all of their needs. My older cat has asthma and she was diagnosed here. And my younger kitten had pneumonia and they successfully diagnosed, while other places failed to do so. They also accept us faster than other places so that’s very helpful. If your pet has an ongoing issue, they will see you sooner. Never felt dismissed and they had great communication on the phone and email pre & post visit.
Friendly and competent staff, with great interaction with the animals.
Doc Meister is a cat guy! Found the problem and got Squeaky her meds and a plan of action and it worked.

Took my pet turtle here to have a check up on some concerns I had. Dr Meister is very knowledgeable and answered all my questions I had for my turtle. His team were super friendly and caring every step of the way. In total for the check up and xray was $299, I am very pleased with the service 😊

The staff and the Veterinary staff are extremely friendly and are willing to help at all times. We have exotic pets and their exotic vet is kind and willing to work with people for the treatment the animals need. I would recommend this place to anyone with exotic/non exotic animals! 10/10

The Center City Vet team was so kind to me and my pup Dimples on our first visit. Dr. Michael Cohen was great with handling the vaccines Dimples needs and showed him so much love. Im glad they are our local vet!

I couldn't NOT recommend this vet enough. Dr. Meister misdiagnosed my cat, prescribing an almost lethal dose of insulin wherein she ended up with a blood sugar of 35 at an emergency center. More than 1 vet indicated the dosage recommended was extraordinarily high. Put her through a bevy of unnecessary tests for the low, low price of $800. This man should be ashamed to call himself a vet. He clearly has no idea what he's doing.
Best vet in Philly.  Dr Cohen treated Max with care and compassion.

My dog Sasha loves Dr.Meister! I have been seeing him since I adopted Sasha three years ago. When I adopted her she had a skin condition. He did many tests on her skin and pointed me towards the dermatology clinic which helped me get her skin under control. He is always so pleasant and nice to talk to. He cares a lot about his patients! I highly recommend Dr.Meister and Center City Vet.

We have been coming to Center City Vet for 5 years now. Dr. Meister is absolutely amazing and always so attentive. My dog loves visiting with him, and everyone at CCV. Even when we lived out of the city for a year, we didn't change vets because we loved Dr. M so much. We have had nothing but wonderful experiences. Can't recommend enough!

Great place! Very clean, always smells nice and clean and im greeted by staff as soon as i walk in. No long wait for appointments. I own a dog daycare up the street and we had a dog that needed vet attention once and they took the dog right away even though it was not anything serious but the dog was a client if theirs. Highly recommend!
Excellent care and compassionate staff.
Really excellent vets that care about the animals and don’t try to upsell unnecessary procedures.  We took our two dogs there and will miss Dr. Cohen now that we’ve moved!

I recommend Center City Veterinary Hospital to everyone! I’ve been bringing my two cats to see Dr. Meister since adopting them at 6 months old (they’re 4 now!) and he is so amazing. He’s incredibly patient, thorough and kind, always putting me at ease when I need to bring my boys in. Emails are answered promptly, they do their best to accommodate appointments as soon as possible and they always follow up after a visit! Amazing experience every time.

I take my pup here and They always take such good care of my baby! They never try and upsell you and genuinely care about the health of your pet. I completely trust them with the care and health of my dog. Every employee (the front desk workers, vet techs and drs) all shower my dog with love and attention whenever we come in for a visit. They are also quick to get you in for an appointment if it is urgent! There are closer vets to where I live but I choose to keep brining my dog  here because I like them so much!
One of the best.
Doctors are so Good approached...All is good.
Great vet clinic, everyone is so attentive and caring!!
